subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Frequency and Hertz
description: A quick win: understand Frequency and Hertz.

hook.text: North America runs on 60 Hz. Europe uses 50 Hz. Both work fine.

buildup.text: Frequency is how many complete cycles AC completes each second, measured in hertz.

discovery.text: Higher frequency means faster reversals. Radio waves oscillate millions of times per second.

twist.text: Mismatched frequency causes clocks to run fast or slow. Your microwave depends on it.

climax.text: Grid operators keep frequency rock-steady — a fraction of a hertz off triggers alarms.

punchline.text: Frequency is the heartbeat of every AC system.

quiz.question: What does 60 Hz mean for an AC power system?
options: The current completes 60 full cycles every second
Power travels at 60 meters per second
